Subject: MedVista compliance kickoff — SOC 2 Type II report & portal access

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Request: MedVista is looking for our SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter covering the gap period for evaluation.
- Next step 1 (Customer): Please confirm which SOC 2 period you need (most customers ask for the most recent Type II period + current bridge letter).
- Next step 2 (Redwood): We will provision access to our trust portal for MedVista’s security reviewers once we have an NDA and the list of contacts to invite.
- Deliverables: SOC 2 Type II report (PDF), bridge letter (PDF), and access to our trust portal where we host evidence and FAQs.

I attached a short vendor security questionnaire you kicked off on the call — filling the highlighted tabs will help our compliance team map evidence quicker.

Would you like us to create the portal invite for security@medvista.com and alice.huang@medvista.com, or do you prefer individual invites? Also please confirm a target date for delivery (e.g., by EOD next Tuesday).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the finish line.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
